arStrings.szText: You look troubled, old man. Perhaps the wisdom of Akarat can bring some Light into your heart?
Speaking to Lorath, who looks forlorn. Trying to be kind and helpful. Pronunciation: Ah-kah-raht
Perhaps my boot can bring some light into your arse. Bugger off, will you?
Annoyed/snapping at the pilgrim. He doesn't want to hear anything about Akarat.
